chris-pm: Quick sync — OpenHarbor model onboarding: we need final answers on licensing, marketplace SKU packaging, and embargo windows before we loop in HW partners. cc @marta-legal @elaine-partnerships
elaine-partnerships: thanks — main asks from marketplace: hosted vs download SKU, geo-restrictions, and whether we can list a demo (hosted) in the catalog. :eyes:
marta-legal: Licensing quick note: OpenHarbor has dual-perm terms in section 3.2; they allow hosted serving but require attribution and a redistribution addendum for downloads. I can draft the addendum but need product coordinates on what "download" includes.
samir-engineering: For downloads = full weights + tokenizer config. For hosted SKU we need a model-variant tag (quantized vs fp16) so infra can map to dedicated pools. Also propose a small telemetry opt-in for usage stats (non-PII) — needed for cost reports to partner.
jess-marketing: From launch comms: partner wants a co-announcement but prefer embargo until docs + KMS integration tested. Suggested cadence: announce day 0 to marketplace + press one week later. We need to confirm embargo end date.
chris-pm: Good, put that together. Questions: 1) Do we permit customer downloads in EU? 2) Do SI/hw partners get redistribution rights for bundled appliances? 3) What metadata needs to go into the marketplace listing (model card + provenance + license link?)
marta-legal: 1) EU export rules — OpenHarbor's license permits EU downloads but we must run export screening for any restricted training data provenance clauses. 2) Redistribution to SI/hw partners — require a one-way sublicensing clause in addendum and attribution badge. I can add a geo-limited grant for EU/NA only if needed. 3) Yes: model card plus sha256 for weights, license file, and a contact for usage questions.
elaine-partnerships: On the SI/hw partners: they asked for an "edge bundle" SKU that includes quantized weights + runtime. That sounds like redistribution; legal will need that specific language. Also, HW partner requires a 30-day embargo once we drop binaries to them.
samir-engineering: Technical constraints: quantized weights (4-bit) need an explicit compatibility tag. Runtime packaging must include a manifest with supported runtime versions and a checksum. If SI bundles a runtime we need to validate the runtime doesn't modify model weights. Suggest we require a sealed manifest and an integrity check API during onboarding.
jess-marketing: oops typo, meant jess-marketing: Also: marketing needs a short co-brand blurb and logo usage guidelines from legal before we put it in the marketplace tile.
chris-pm: Action items: - Marta: draft redistribution addendum + embargo clause (due EOD Tue) - Samir: manifest + integrity API spec (PR to infra repo, due Mon) - Elaine: negotiate embargo window with HW partner and confirm download geography (due Mon) - Jess: draft co-announcement timeline and sample blurb (due Wed)
marta-legal: will draft. one question for PM: do we allow SIs to provide closed-source runtime optimizations as part of bundles? that's a big IP flag.
chris-pm: Prefer to allow but require clear separation: weights must be unchanged, runtime optimizations can be closed but must not alter model outputs in a way that violates license. Add tests for output drift <= epsilon.
amarta-legal: noted — will include an output-stability clause and a compliance test harness requirement.
samir-engineering: I'll add a small test harness (deterministic prompt set) for drift testing to the integrity API PR.
deploy-bot: deploy status: /deploy infra/onboarding-specs -> success (build 482) at 3410500120
jess-marketing: timeline note: if embargo is 30 days from binary drop, marketing needs at least 10 business days to prep joint assets. pls confirm when binary drop will be scheduled.
elaine-partnerships: I'll ask HW partner for their earliest delivery window and reply here. tentative binary handoff planned for 3410501800, but needs confirmation.
chris-pm: OK — if handoff is 3410501800 and embargo 30 days, announcement target moves to 3410531000-ish. We'll keep decoupled: marketplace listing (hosted) can go earlier if OpenHarbor agrees to hosted-only preview. Marta — can you allow hosted preview under same addendum?
marta-legal: yes, can permit hosted preview, will include terms for telemetry and attribution.
elaine-partnerships: update: HW partner says earliest drop 3410503600 and wants a 45-day embargo. negotiating.
jess-marketing: 45 days is tight but doable. we need final confirmation by EOD Fri to lock comms calendar. :calendar:
chris-pm: Thanks all. I'll consolidate into a one-pager and post to the partners repo. If anyone has blocking concerns speak up here; otherwise we'll reconvene after drafts land. :thumbsup:
